svg.title: Three-floor PCB placement — Ing. Alex M. Rivera
svg.desc: Top view of each unrouted board. Original proven contours preserved; components upwards and male connectors on upper undersides. ADS1115 body projection is provisional.

g.text: Same orientation and scale · top views · red: front pads · blue: through-hole copper
No tracks / copper zones · module and optical body fit remain provisional · all three cuvette openings retained.
